prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Alien game world brown plain under orange-red sky, two suns overhead with third red glow below horizon. 
SCENE: 상구의 얼굴. 공포. 입이 떨린다. 눈이 크게 떨린다. 그가 말을 잇는다. 닥터슬럼프풍 과장 — 눈이 만화적으로 크지만, 뺨에 흐르는 땀이 리얼리스틱. 과장과 리얼리즘의 충돌이 불안감을 극대화.
Visible named cast: 상구. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
